entities.summary: Lars Vegard was a Norwegian physicist who is a pioneer in crystallography. He also made contributions to materials science and the science of aurora borealis. The Vegard's law in solid state chemistry and materials science, the only law of nature formulated by a Norwegian, is named after him. Lars Vegard was a writers & intellectuals from Vegårshei Municipality (1880-02-03, Vegårshei Municipality–1963-12-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
